explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/679: for ε > 0, are there infinitely many n with ω(n−k) < (1+ε)log k/log log k for all k < n sufficiently large depending only on ε? The statement gives, for each ε > 0, a threshold K (depending only on ε) and infinitely many n with the bound for all K < k < n. Faithful.
